activity.notes: ATLAS uses 742 as Li Bai's representative Tang literary-activity year, when Emperor Xuanzong appointed him to the Hanlin Academy. The bounded milestone avoids representing his full wandering literary life as one continuous court Activity.

sources.title: Li Bai — Poetry Foundation
sources.citation_text: Poetry Foundation identifies Li Bai as a Tang-dynasty poet and records his appointment to the Hanlin Academy by Emperor Xuanzong in 742.
